record_scope_reconstruction: India-side Kartarpur corridor pilgrimage suspension, represented by Dera Baba Nanak passenger terminal. Pakistani domestic shrine access, Pakistan-side permissions and Attari journeys are outside this phase.

source_checks.finding: Official MHA release suspends Kartarpur travel/registration from March 16, 2020.
Official MHA release identifies corridor resumption from November 17, 2021 and the Dera Baba Nanak boundary agreement.
LPAI identifies the passenger terminal, November 2019 inauguration and COVID movement suspension.
Named Indian immigration complex outline inspected; Pakistani terminal and shrine are distinct features.

sites.name: Dera Baba Nanak Kartarpur passenger terminal
sites.coordinate_method: Mean of unique vertices in fresh OSM named feature outline
sites.precision: Approximate crossing area, about 100 m; not the historical barrier footprint
sites.evidence_note: Explicit Immigration Complex, Dera Baba Nanak building and border_control outline. Indian MHA and LPAI identify the Indian passenger terminal as the processing point for the Kartarpur corridor opened in November 2019. Mapcarta country-label error is not adopted.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: India-side Kartarpur corridor pilgrimage suspension, represented by Dera Baba Nanak passenger terminal. Pakistani domestic shrine access, Pakistan-side permissions and Attari journeys are outside this phase.

date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: Exact interval concerns India-side pilgrimage suspension, not a claim that both governments continuously closed every movement. Newspaper June-year wording differs from Pakistan’s official 2020 statement, so no bilateral reopening chronology inferred. Other pilgrimage routes and Pakistani domestic access to shrine are outside this record.

independence_statement: Pass B reconstruction from original-source retrievals and coordinate evidence; no pass A files or judgments consulted.
